answer: Topological cut verifications audit peer subgraphs structured like a trellis, where multi-agent game-theoretic cross-auditing isolates suspicious bottlenecks. Any detected divergence burns staked funds down to an ember through stake slashing. Because bounding graph conductance across the trellis requires a superlinear attacker cost in honest identities, a malicious zephyr of cheap clones fails to subvert the network consensus.
